a.lede: ​Attackers are now actively exploiting a high-severity vulnerability in Zyxel GS1900 series switches, according to the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA). [...]
a.title: CISA orders feds to patch Zyxel flaw exploited for data theft

b.lede: Cybersecurity company Check Point has confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-85102, a pre-authentication remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the VPN certificate-handling functionality of its Security Gateway product. [...]
b.title: Check Point warns of hackers exploiting Security Gateway VPN RCE flaw
